reviews.title: Lots of great info
reviews.contents: I really enjoy this app, it’s great to get updates along the way, with lots of interesting and useful info. Easy to use and fun, too!

reviews.title: Went woke
reviews.contents: They switched from alternating articles describing your baby as ‘he’ one day to ‘she’ the next. Now it’s ‘they’ in every article so it is very impersonal and you’re just left disgusted that even a baby development app is trying to come for your kids and give them mental illness by confusing them about basic human biology.

reviews.title: Very useful and helpful
reviews.contents: I love the app, it’s very insightful and prepares me for the different stages of growth my toddler goes through!

reviews.title: Bumpie photos
reviews.contents: The bumpie photos in tools is terrible. Have to keep uploading the pictures because they don’t save all the time and somethings they just turn out white when trying to go through them.

reviews.title: Previous version was better!
reviews.contents: Great app with lots of helpful info, tips and videos! But I really liked the previous version, ever since the app was updated there’s less information, more adds, I don’t like it at all. I keep checking the app less actually, before I used to scroll and see what’s ahead or remember what it was like in the beginning when my baby was little...

reviews.title: I preferred the previous version
reviews.contents: I’m disappointed with the new layout. It seems there is less articles and I used to like to be able to browse through the weekly content. It’s just not as conviennent or user friendly anymore.

reviews.title: An informative free app
reviews.contents: We have been using the app throughout our pregnancy. It gives information which helped us understand the pregnancy journey better. It kept us well informed, easy to track and a lot of other good features and info.

reviews.title: Very informative
reviews.contents: I like to open the app for daily insight

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.contents: Won’t even let me delete my account. They don’t respond to emails and they don’t send deletion confirmation either like they say they would.
